title: CSV 账单对账
Billing reconciliation from CSV
summary: 读两份 CSV（发票和收款），找出已付清、部分付款、多付和未付的发票，标出对不上的收款和坏行，不能因为一行脏数据就整体崩掉。
Read two CSV files, invoices and payments, and sort the invoices into paid, partly paid, overpaid and unpaid, flagging payments that do not match and bad rows without crashing on dirty data.
